label: Day 1 — Charlottesville to Wytheville, VA
summary: Departed mid-afternoon heading west on I-64. First photos within an hour of leaving. Ended the day in Wytheville at a Tesla Supercharger parking lot, sleeping in or near the car.
highlight: PXL_20240529_003826670_MP.jpg — Serenity at sunset, Wytheville. First night on the road.

label: Day 2 — Wytheville layover
summary: Barely moved from the previous night's stop. Morning spent in Wytheville, including a detour to photograph the Mountain Lynx Transit agency sign. Departed later for a long overnight drive.
highlight: PXL_20240529_163555745.jpg — Mountain Lynx Transit sign. Couldn't help himself.

label: Day 3 — Overnight push through Kentucky and Cincinnati
summary: No photos until evening, indicating a long driving day with no stops. Arrived in the Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky area by nightfall. Ohio River industrial shots at dusk.
highlight: PXL_20240531_005220787.jpg — Power plant reflected in the Ohio River at dusk.

label: Day 4 — Peoria to Lincoln, NE
summary: A long Midwest push. Hit Peoria at 9am, crossed the Mississippi at 10:30 with a cluster of bridge and river photos, stopped at Iowa 80 World's Largest Truck Stop, detoured into Riverside Iowa for the Kirk birthplace (~2 minutes on the ground), continued through Omaha and into Nebraska under a spectacular storm sky.
highlight: PXL_20240531_175619257.jpg — Future Birthplace of Captain James T. Kirk, Riverside Iowa.

label: Day 5 — Laramie to Millers, NV (the monster day)
summary: Wyoming at 8am — Elk Mountain with snow and snow fences. Green River tunnels through layered geology. Welcome to Utah, the Wasatch peaks, the Great Salt Lake causeway, the Bonneville Salt Flats (walked on them), the Tree of Utah sculpture. Crossed into Nevada, arrived at Millers Rest Stop around 8:30pm local. Stayed until after 10pm shooting stars. Best single day of the trip.
highlight: PXL_20240602_043831330_NIGHT.jpg — Stars at Millers Rest Stop, Esmeralda County, NV. Best sky of the trip.

label: Day 6 — Millers to the Pacific Coast
summary: Through Reno by 9:48am (Infinity Highway sign). Into northern California by noon via the Lassen corridor — alpine meadow, tall pines. Standing on a dark sand beach in Humboldt County at 5:51pm, picking up a rock. Western terminus. Drove back south on I-5 into the night.
highlight: PXL_20240603_005103898.jpg — Rock in hand at the Pacific Ocean, Humboldt County. The western terminus.

label: Day 7 — Northern California to Eastern Sierra
summary: Crossed the Sierra eastbound in clouds and rain — passed a CMS sign reading 'Wagon Train Traveling West Over Summit' while heading east. Came down through the Sierra foothills, then south on US-395 through the Eastern Sierra. Mammoth Lakes area by 2:50pm with snow-capped peaks straight ahead.
highlight: PXL_20240603_215042570.jpg — US-395 aimed at snow-loaded Eastern Sierra peaks near Mammoth.

label: Day 8 — Vasquez Rocks to Mojave Road to Victorville
summary: Vasquez Rocks at 9:26am — walked the formations, multiple shots. Joshua Tree country by 1pm. Barstow/Mojave area mid-afternoon, Serenity absolutely filthy in the sunset photo. Then the Mojave Road Historic Route — drove a stretch of the actual dirt track, photographed a rock cairn with an American flag in the middle of a dry lakebed. Only hotel night of the trip in Victorville.
highlight: PXL_20240604_233612398_MP.jpg — Serenity at desert sunset, Virginia plates, completely covered in road grime.

label: Day 9 — Goodsprings NV to Capitol Reef, UT
summary: Pioneer Saloon in Goodsprings NV by 9:47am. I-15 north through the Virgin River Gorge into Utah, dramatic red canyon walls. St. George/Hurricane corridor with panoramic overlooks. Capitol Reef area by evening — Serenity parked at a remote desert rest stop. Green River canyon at dusk.
highlight: PXL_20240605_201536349_MP.jpg — Red canyon panorama near St. George, shadow of the photographer in the foreground.

label: Day 10 — Moab to Gray County, TX
summary: Wilson Arch near Moab at 9:46am. Hole N' The Rock on US-191. Big push east and south through the canyon country of eastern Utah, across New Mexico, into Texas. Gray County Rest Area by 10:19pm local — long exposure photography at the rest area, Texas star monument shots, storm on the horizon.
highlight: PXL_20240607_034429620_LONG_EXPOSURE-01_COVER.jpg — Long exposure at Gray County Rest Area, car headlights streaking through the frame.

label: Day 11 — Gray County to Memphis to Charlottesville
summary: Gray County through the Texas Panhandle and Oklahoma. Memphis at 6:22pm — Bass Pro Shops Pyramid from the I-40 bridge crossing the Mississippi into Tennessee. Straight through to Charlottesville. Arrived home 07:04 on June 8.
highlight: PXL_20240607_232227271_MP.jpg — Memphis Bass Pro Pyramid from the bridge. Last major landmark of the trip.
